grammarFocus: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门。
title: Li Ming's Healthy Habits
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过规定的字数。请根据短文内容选择或填写答案。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
passage:
Li Ming is a 25-year-old office worker in Shanghai. He wants to be healthy, so he plans his day carefully. He should sleep eight hours every night because sleep is important for his body and mind. He should go to bed before 11 p.m. because late sleep makes him tired. He should drink warm milk before bed because it helps him relax. He should not use his phone in bed because the light is bad for sleep.

On Monday, Li Ming follows his plan. He goes to bed at 10:30 p.m. and sleeps for eight hours. On Tuesday, he feels great. He is happier than on Monday because he sleeps well. He tells his friend Wang Wei, "I am the happiest man in the office today!" Wang Wei laughs and says, "You are also the earliest person here!"

On Wednesday, Li Ming has a lot of work, so he goes to bed at 1 a.m. He sleeps only five hours. On Thursday, he is very tired. He is more tired than on Tuesday. He drinks coffee because he needs energy. He says, "I should sleep earlier tonight because I want to feel good tomorrow."

On Friday, Li Ming goes to bed at 10 p.m. He sleeps for nine hours. On Saturday, he feels the best. He thinks, "Sleep is the most important thing for my health." He also eats more vegetables and does more exercise because he wants to be healthier. He is now the healthiest person in his family.

questions.prompt: Why does Li Ming plan his day carefully?
options: Because he wants to be healthy.
Because he wants to be rich.
Because he wants to be famous.
answers: Because he wants to be healthy.
questions.explanation: 原文第一段第一句说“He wants to be healthy, so he plans his day carefully.”，因此他仔细计划一天的原因是想保持健康。
questions.evidence: He wants to be healthy, so he plans his day carefully.

questions.evidence: He should go to bed before 11 p.m. because late sleep makes him tired.

grammar.title: because / so; should; 比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示原因，so 表示结果。should 表示“应该”，用来提建议。比较级用于两者比较，如 happier（更快乐）；最高级用于三者或以上比较，如 the happiest（最快乐）。
grammar.example: He is happier than on Monday because he sleeps well.

questions.prompt: I am tired, ______ I go to bed early.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，所以用 so 连接。

questions.prompt: You ______ drink more water every day.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议，这里建议多喝水，所以用 should。
两者比较用比较级，tall 的比较级是 taller。

questions.prompt: She is the ______ girl in her class.
questions.explanation: 三者或以上比较用最高级，happy 的最高级是 happiest。
